summary: Backend-only test pass for TestFlight Build 119 Bug 15 (TTS) + Bug 16 (STT) refactor — user chose Option (a): refactor SpeakButton internally to cloud TTS + align VoiceInputButton native FormData path with the working George file-object approach. STRUCTURAL + BACKEND-CONTRACT SCOPE ONLY per the review request — physical iPhone AVAudioRecorder lifecycle and cloud-mp3 AVAudioPlayer playback CANNOT be verified from this web-preview sandbox. Results: 25/25 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter89_speakbutton_cloud_refactor.py. Verified: (1) SpeakButton.tsx no longer imports expo-speech; imports georgeApi.speak + shared claimActiveSpeaker/getCachedUri/setCachedUri/releaseActiveSpeaker from tts-shared; Props (text/size/color/bg/testID/rate/pitch) preserved so all 22 call-site files continue to compile; (2) GeorgeSpeakButton.tsx now imports the SAME shared registry (single _activeStop singleton) — no more duplicated module-level state; (3) tts-shared.ts exports claimActiveSpeaker, releaseActiveSpeaker, getCachedUri, setCachedUri, clearUriCache; (4) george-api.ts speak() checks `new File(Paths.cache, filename).exists` BEFORE the network fetch, gated on Platform.OS !== 'web'; (5) VoiceInputButton.tsx has Platform.OS branching — on web it uses fetch(uri).blob(), on native it appends {uri,name,type} directly (matching the proven-working useGeorgeVoiceInput/georgeApi.transcribe pattern); field name is 'audio' on both branches; (6) Backend contracts: /api/voice/transcribe still accepts field 'audio' (422 on empty POST, 400 on empty-bytes audio field), /api/mcgs/george/transcribe still expects field 'file' (422 when 'audio' sent instead), /api/mcgs/george/speak requires auth (401 unauth). All three endpoints reachable, no 5xx regressions. Metro bundles cleanly (1569 modules, no errors); Expo web preview returns 200. app.json build pins remain 1.0.12 / iOS 119 / Android 119 — untouched.
action_items: DEVICE-TEST REQUIRED (only reproducible on TestFlight hardware, not in web preview): (Bug 15) Install a fresh TestFlight build on Garry's iPhone. On Home tap the speaker on 'Today's Thought'; on Notices tap a notice's speaker; open a DM and tap a bubble speaker; open a recipe and tap the read-aloud; open a game (memory/trivia/crossword) and tap the how-to-play speaker. EXPECTED: George's cloud voice (OpenAI onyx/nova) plays consistently — never the Apple robotic voice. First tap downloads mp3; subsequent taps of the same text on any screen should be near-instant (disk cache hit named `george-<voice>-<hash>.mp3` in the app cache dir). If cloud fetch fails, the button silently fails (SpeakButton has no toast context by design) — no fallback to expo-speech.

DEVICE-TEST REQUIRED (Bug 16): On the same TestFlight build, tap the mic button next to a text input in FP Cafe, Private Chat, Groups, Recipes, Tables. Speak 2-3 seconds. Tap to stop. EXPECTED: transcript appears in the input; NO 'Sorry, I couldn't hear you clearly' banner. This is the same native FormData shape that /api/mcgs/george/transcribe uses successfully, so it should now match parity.

FOLLOW-UP (out of scope for this refactor but Garry may raise): three files still call `Speech.speak(...)` directly (Apple TTS), so those specific auto-read paths will still play the robotic voice on native: (i) app/dm/[id].tsx L49 auto-reads incoming DM messages via WebSocket, (ii) app/games/bingo/player.tsx L74 announces the called number, (iii) app/games/bingo/player.tsx L100 says 'Bingo! Well done!'. These aren't tap-to-read speaker buttons (they're auto-triggered), so they're technically outside Bug 15's 'every speaker button' phrasing, but they DO produce Apple's voice mid-app. Recommend a separate follow-up ticket to move DM auto-read + bingo callouts to georgeApi.speak as well if Garry reports 'the voice is still robotic when a new DM arrives / when the bingo caller speaks'.

FOLLOW-UP: /app/frontend/src/components/george/GeorgeOnboarding.tsx L13 still imports `import * as Speech from 'expo-speech'` — but only calls `Speech.stop()` on unmount (L88), never `Speech.speak`. Harmless. Could be cleaned up in a future pass since expo-speech is no longer used for playback anywhere onboarding-related.
critical_code_review_comments: SpeakButton.tsx (170 lines): clean rewrite. Public prop signature preserved (text/size/color/bg/testID/rate/pitch) so all 22 call-site files compile unchanged. rate/pitch are documented as ignored (cloud TTS controls prosody server-side) but kept for backwards compat — good.

SpeakButton + GeorgeSpeakButton now share tts-shared.ts singletons — only ONE speaker plays app-wide at a time. Tapping SpeakButton on a recipe correctly stops a George bubble playing on the previous screen. Prevents overlapping voices.

george-api.ts speak() (L313-362): disk cache check (`new File(Paths.cache, filename).exists`) happens BEFORE the fetch on native; on web falls straight through to the network. Cache filename is `george-<voice>-<shortHash(text)>.mp3` so voice-change invalidates automatically. The `_shortHash` DJB2 variant is fine for locality (not security).

VoiceInputButton.tsx L268-297: Platform.OS branching is correct. Native path appends {uri,name,type} object directly — RN's FormData stream reads the file from disk without going through JS blob (which is what broke on TestFlight hardware). Web path retains the blob route because RN's file-object shortcut serialises to '[object Object]' on web. Field name is 'audio' on both branches, matching /api/voice/transcribe's parameter name.
app.json pins verified: version 1.0.12 / iOS buildNumber 119 / Android versionCode 119 — untouched as required.
Metro bundle succeeds (1569 modules, ~1.1s) with the refactored code — no compile-time regressions across the 22 SpeakButton call sites.

rca_of_issue: Prior iterations (85-88) added defensive changes to the OLD blob-based upload path in VoiceInputButton (150ms AVAudioSession warm-up, isRecording guard, blob-size check) but that path itself was the root cause: `fetch(file://…).blob()` is unreliable on physical iOS devices in TestFlight builds, producing 0-byte or corrupt blobs even when the underlying m4a is fine. The George chat path (useGeorgeVoiceInput → georgeApi.transcribe) never had this problem because it appends the file object directly to FormData, letting RN's native FormData serializer stream from disk. Iter89 refactor makes the failing path use the same file-object approach on native (blob only on web), which structurally can no longer produce 0-byte uploads regardless of the audio session state. Bug 15 RCA: the previous 'cloud voice for George surfaces only' scoping (iter88) left every non-George speaker on expo-speech, i.e. Apple's OS voice — jarring for members who hear TWO different voices in the same app. Iter89 moves ALL SpeakButton call sites to cloud TTS in ONE place (the component itself), with disk-caching keyed by voice+hash so cost stays bounded. Repeated taps of the same text (across app restarts until iOS reclaims the cache) hit the disk with zero network cost.
